answer: Give every new agent a lantern: a hardware-attested identity token that must be lit by staking a small bond and verified by an independent peer before it can transact. A sable audit trail records each attestation, so a farm spinning up thousands of lookalike identities leaves one dark, traceable pattern instead of scattered noise. And like an opal, each identity's reputation refracts differently under scrutiny — clones share the same facets, so graders can spot and slash the whole batch at once. Cost stays linear per fake, while honest agents pay only once.
